Night Recap on 𝕏: December 29, 2024 – Trending and Breaking News.

Politics & Leadership

•Mississippi Valley State University Band to Perform at Trump’s Inauguration Parade: The "Mean Green Marching Machine" is set to participate in the 60th Presidential Inauguration Parade for President Donald Trump on January 20, 2025, showcasing its rich cultural legacy.

•Trump on Debt Ceiling Extension: Trump criticized a previous debt ceiling extension, labeling it a “dumb political decision” and calling for Democrats to address the issue immediately.

•Trump Warns EU About Tariffs: President-elect Trump threatened tariffs against the EU if they do not purchase U.S. oil and gas at scale.

•Term Limits Push: Trump reaffirmed his intention to pursue a constitutional amendment imposing term limits on Congress.

Health & Safety

•Bird Flu Pet Food Recall: Oregon-based Northwest Naturals recalled its Turkey Recipe pet food after a cat died from bird flu. The contaminated food tested positive for the H5N1 strain and was sold in 12 U.S. states and parts of Canada.

•Flu Outbreak in China: Hospitals are overwhelmed as influenza A and human metapneumovirus cases surge, drawing comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic.

Crime & Justice

•BLM Protests in NYC: Activists marched through Times Square, demanding justice for Robert Brooks, who died in a Utica, NY, prison incident allegedly involving guards.

•Mayor Arrested on Child Porn Charges: Former Mayor Patrick Wojahn of College Park, MD, and a White House guest, faces 56 counts of child pornography.

•Tren de Aragua's Growing Presence: Experts warn that the violent Venezuelan gang, Tren de Aragua, is now active in 18 states, with potential expansion to over 25 states by February.

Global Affairs

•Asma al-Assad Barred from the UK: The UK confirmed that Syrian First Lady Asma al-Assad cannot enter the country despite holding citizenship.

•Jeju Air Crash Investigation: The U.S. NTSB is assisting South Korea in probing the Jeju Air crash that claimed 179 lives.

Science & Technology

•SpaceX Highlighted by BBC: BBC named SpaceX's Starship booster catch one of the top science highlights of 2024.

•Elon Musk on Mars: Musk suggested direct democracy for Martian governance and hinted at uncrewed Starship missions to Mars within two years, with crewed missions in about four years.

Social Media & Culture

•Elon Musk Advocates Positivity on X: Musk encouraged users to share more positive and informative content on the platform.

•Cristiano Ronaldo Sparks Debate: Ronaldo claimed the Saudi League is superior to Ligue 1 and stated that Vinicius Jr. deserved the Ballon d’Or.

Miscellaneous

•Jimmy Carter’s Passing: Former President Jimmy Carter, a Nobel Peace Prize winner, passed away at age 100 in Plains, Georgia.

•Bigfoot Tragedy: Two men died from exposure while searching for Bigfoot in a Washington state forest, highlighting the dangers of ill-prepared expeditions.

•True Crime Misinformation: A viral misunderstanding about a true crime documentary involving Carrie turned serious when it was revealed she and her girlfriend murdered her mother. The incident emphasizes the need for fact-checking in media.

Key Questions Raised

•Should the U.S. take more aggressive steps to counter the spread of Tren de Aragua?

•How do you feel about Trump’s call for term limits or his stance on the EU and tariffs?

•Are Elon Musk's plans for Mars realistic, and should direct democracy be the model for Martian governance?

Which story caught your attention the most? Share your thoughts in the comments, and don’t forget to like and share!
